summary: Completed all 9 plan phases: PSS-based reclaimable accounting with shared-page de-duplication, a CPU-delta idle state machine replacing the broken pcpu/etimes gate, a 1 GB memory-floor cost gate, a re-verifying --lean-tree targeted-termination mode, and a notify-before-kill desktop prompt path with snooze/dedupe/graceful-degrade. Fixed a real implementation bug found by the new tests (state-merge dropping prompted/snooze_until on every detection pass) and a real downstream SKILL.md defect (stale confirmation-trigger string). Test suite grew from 112 to 163 passing assertions. Redeployed via deploy-headless.sh (RESULT=landed_verify_clean) and verified byte-identical to source.
